tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Please refer tender document for all the terms and conditions (vertical evaluation)

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder shall have successfully supplied Locomotive spares to any coal handling/material handling system to any sector/PSU/Major power plants/reputed private sector/major industries in previous five years from the date of tender notification. In proof of the same, bidder shall upload supportive documents (Purchase orders/supply orders), amounting to Rs 8.6 lakhs / above, issued by competent authority.

The bidder shall be a Manufacturer/Authorized dealer/supplier of Locomotive spares and should have supplied to any PSU/Major power plants /reputed private sector/major industries. As a documentary proof, dealership/Manufacture certificate/PO copy shall be uploaded.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- RELEVANT DOCUMENTS SHALL BE UPLOADED

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder shall have achieved, in his name/firm, an average annual turnover of Rs. 17.20 lakhs / above in at least two financial years in the preceding five financial years i.e., (2021-22 to 2025-26). As a proof of this, the bidder shall furnish Annual Turnover Certificate / Profit & Loss statement /Annual financial statements, duly certified by a chartered accountant.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Annual turnover certificate duly certified by a CA

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Profit & Loss Statement/ Annual turnover certified by CA
